title: MaverIQ: Fingerprint-Guided Extrapolation and Fragmentation-Aware Layering for Intent-Based LLM Serving
problem: Deploying LLMs optimally requires manual exploration of parallelism/compression configurations; existing solutions rely on expensive profiling and suboptimally utilize fragmented cluster resources
motivation: LLM serving requires balancing latency, cost, and accuracy across diverse user intents; automating configuration selection could reduce operational cost by orders of magnitude
method: Fingerprint-based extrapolation: profile small LLM proxy under few configs, analytically extrapolate to full model; fragmentation-aware layering exploits uneven layer distribution for cost optimization
key_novelty: First intent-based LLM serving system; combines fingerprinting with analytical extrapolation to eliminate expensive full-model profiling; novel fragmentation-aware deployment
contributions: Analytical extrapolation from proxy to full LLM
Consistent user intent satisfaction across LLMs/loads
limitations: Fingerprint extrapolation accuracy depends on model architecture similarity; fragmentation benefits vary by cluster topology; generalization across different hardware types not discussed
